changelog:
1.6.2 — Smash Through the Walls
  ADDED: Wall capture — a player snake that completely surrounds a connected wall group with a closed loop destroys it
  ADDED: Wall groups are 8-directionally connected across toroidal edges; every tile must be fully enclosed before the whole group is removed
  ADDED: Wall destruction triggers the existing wall crumble animation and a new wall-shatter sound effect
  ADDED: Destroyed walls stop blocking movement, boss pathing, and food spawning immediately
  FIXED: All boss types (CHASER, WALL_BUILDER, HEALER) consistently play the default boss damage and boss defeat sounds
